name: Toki
source:
A girl dressed as a shrine maiden who appears to have come from a foreign land.
She claims that the protagonist is her older brother...?
She appears in the story when certain conditions are met.

[Translated  from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040202001505/http://www.cherrysoft.co.jp/cherrysoft/kyrie.htm]the official site[/url]]
